projects.name: Scure: Weblink Scanner
projects.line: A mobile app that tells you whether a link is safe, just by pointing your phone camera at it.
points: A mobile app with camera-based QR scanning and on-device text recognition, so users can check a suspicious link by pointing their phone at it instead of typing it out.

A threat analysis engine in Node.js and Express.js that checks links against VirusTotal, Google Safe Browsing, URLScan.io, and a blocklist seeded from URLhaus and government-banned sites, so users are warned about phishing and malware before opening a link.

Sandboxed page analysis: suspicious pages open in an isolated Playwright headless browser, and Google Gemini flags obfuscated scripts and credential-harvesting forms, so threats that slip past blocklists still get caught.
Gemini and Groq combine all scanner results into one plain-English verdict, so people without technical knowledge can tell whether a link is safe.
The REST API is secured with JWT login, bcrypt password hashing and rate limiting, so user accounts and scan history stay protected from abuse.
As team lead I ran weekly sprints and code reviews, set up automatic deployment to Railway from the develop branch, and changed features based on user testing and our faculty advisor's feedback.
projects.stack: React Native, Expo, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL (Supabase), JWT, bcrypt, Playwright, Google Gemini, Groq, VirusTotal, Google Safe Browsing, URLScan.io, URLhaus, Railway

projects.name: PolicyLens: Policy Compliance Checker
projects.line: Checks company contracts against compliance policies, and re-checks them automatically whenever a rule changes.
points: A Python and FastAPI back-end that parses uploaded PDF and Word policies, saves each version, and re-checks every stored contract when a rule changes, so legal teams learn right away when an approved contract stops complying.

A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline that pulls the most similar clauses from the company's own records before the AI gives its verdict, so every answer is based on real documents instead of guesses.
Deployed the React front-end and API through GitHub Actions with a teammate, so we could show judges a live, working product by the end of the day.
projects.stack: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Supabase, pgvector, Azure AI Foundry (GPT-4o), OpenAI embeddings, React, GitHub Actions

projects.name: S.H.I.E.L.D: AI Incident Response Assistant
projects.event: National AI Student Challenge 2026, Certis Track
projects.line: A hands-free voice assistant that helps security officers report, classify and respond to incidents while on patrol.
points: A push-to-talk voice assistant that streams audio over WebSockets into speech-to-text and a local Mistral model, which classifies the incident, assesses severity and suggests escalation.
Spoken replies with ElevenLabs text-to-speech, so officers hear the next step out loud.
DeepFace face search across CCTV frames against a missing-person watchlist.
Incident logging to Supabase PostgreSQL with Redis caching, so supervisors get a clear timeline.
Packaged with Docker Compose. I split features with a teammate so both halves fit together for the final demo.
projects.stack: Python, FastAPI, React, WebSockets, faster-whisper (Whisper STT), Ollama with Mistral, ElevenLabs TTS, DeepFace, Redis, Supabase PostgreSQL, Docker Compose

projects.name: STEMulate: Learning Management System
projects.line: An all-in-one system for a tutoring centre to run classes, grading, payments and progress updates.
points: Separate dashboards for admins, teachers, students and parents.
Live quizzes and proctored tests with Express.js and Socket.IO, so teachers can follow each student's progress in real time during an online exam.
AES-256 encryption for uploaded files and row-level security in PostgreSQL, so student records stay private.
PayMongo payments through webhooks, so parents can pay fees online.
projects.stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase (PostgreSQL), Express.js, Socket.IO, AES-256, PayMongo

projects.name: IOC Enricher: Threat Intelligence Tool
projects.line: Paste in alert text and get every IP, domain and hash checked against threat intelligence sources in one step.
points: A command-line tool that uses regular expressions to pull IP addresses, domains and MD5/SHA hashes out of alert text, then looks each one up on VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB and Shodan, so an analyst can triage indicators in one step.
Reports in JSON, Markdown and Word (DOCX), so findings can be attached to a ticket or shared with non-technical managers.
projects.stack: Python, regular expressions, VirusTotal API, AbuseIPDB API, Shodan API, DOCX/Markdown/JSON reporting

projects.name: Help Out, Reach Out: CSR Volunteer Matching Platform
projects.line: Matches company volunteers with people who need help.
points: A volunteer matching platform with separate menus for CSR representatives, people in need, and admins.
PHPUnit tests running in GitHub Actions.
Led weekly sprints and updated features after client feedback, so each release matched what users asked for.
projects.stack: PHP, MySQL, object-oriented programming (boundary-control-entity design), PHPUnit, GitHub Actions

projects.name: Shadow AI Data Leakage Prevention Prototype
projects.line: A proxy that stops staff from pasting confidential data into personal AI chatbots.
points: A proxy that screens prompts sent to AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Claude, blocks unapproved AI services and confidential keywords, and alerts admins, so companies can let staff use AI safely without leaking sensitive data.
